name: Mouwasat Hospital
verdict: Mouwasat Hospital is part of Mouwasat Medical Services Company, a hospital group listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 4002) whose largest shareholders are company insiders holding about 18% each; no state or state fund is in the chain. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: listed Saudi healthcare company, insider-owned (Al-Saleem / Al-Subaie families, ~53% combined per Simply Wall St, May 2020); no state or fund stake identified in the sources opened → none.
